title: ballota nigra subsp. velutina
intro: Ballota nigra subsp. velutina, commonly known as Velvet Horehound, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include relief from anxiety and stress due to its health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antispasmodic. The therapeutic actions of Velvet Horehound involve its ability to calm the nervous system, making it useful in treating conditions such as insomnia and restlessness. The bioactive constituents present in Velvet Horehound include rosmarinic acid, luteolin, and ursolic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
